about:
Axon Medical Technologies is based in New Cumberland, Pennsylvania. The company was founded in 2003 by Michael Zarreii, who serves as chief executive and chief scientific officer. Zarreii began the venture as a philanthropic effort to explore the connection between the brain’s involuntary sensory functions and cognition, aiming to develop advanced diagnostic and therapeutic devices.

The company designs and manufactures two primary platforms: ECAT™, a point-of-care multi-screening system for primary care clinics, and Intellig-EYES™, a neurological performance measurement headgear. Both are produced in an FDA-registered facility in the United States. The platforms automate assessments such as pupillometry, cognitive testing (Trail Making Test, GPCOG, MMSE, CAPS-5), and rapid concussion screening. Axon Medical is currently expanding its manufacturing capacity to serve both commercial and military markets.

The technology targets primary care and family practice clinics, as well as military healthcare settings. The U.S. Army has funded a four-year study to integrate ECAT and Intellig-EYES into treatment protocols for service members. The platforms also support sports medicine through sideline concussion detection. Customers include clinic owners and healthcare providers who lease the devices under a per-scan billing model with CPT code reimbursement.

Zarreii’s original vision was to solve complex neurological challenges through non-invasive, objective, and automated testing. The company differentiates itself with portable, lightweight devices that generate real-time, color-coded results and clinical documentation, all while minimizing financial risk for providers through a leasing structure rather than direct sales.
